# Flaky tests
The integration suite flakes when two tests bind port 8080. Run them with --test-threads=1 or pick a free port with portpicker.

# CI runners
The macOS runner is slow, and a flaky network step there retries three times before failing the job.

candidates.name: database-backups.md
candidates.heading: Database backups
candidates.body:
# Database backups
Nightly pg_dump to the backups bucket; restores are tested monthly.

candidates.name: migration-guide.md
candidates.heading: Migrating from v1 config
candidates.body:
# Migrating from v1 config
Users move lantern.yaml to lantern.toml; the converter is lantern config migrate.

candidates.name: sqlite-locking.md
candidates.heading: SQLite locking
candidates.body:
# SQLite locking
The database is opened in WAL mode. A migration that rewrites a table takes an exclusive lock, so run it with the daemon stopped.

candidates.name: schema-changes.md
candidates.heading: Schema changes
candidates.body:
# Schema changes
Add a numbered SQL file under migrations/ and run make migrate. Never edit an applied migration; write a new one.

Write one bullet per user-visible change, in the past tense.

Cut a hotfix branch from the last tag, cherry-pick the fix, and tag a patch release.

candidates.name: coverage.md
candidates.heading: Coverage
candidates.body:
# Coverage
Coverage is cut off at 80 percent in CI; lower it only with a reason in the pull request.

candidates.name: logging.md

candidates.body:
# Logging
Set LANTERN_LOG=debug. Logs go to ~/.local/state/lantern/lantern.log and rotate at 10 MB.

candidates.name: changelog.md

candidates.body:
# Changelog
The changelog is generated from release-notes/*.md; never edit it by hand.

candidates.name: audit-trail.md

# Audit trail
Permission decisions are written to the audit table in the state database.

Panics write a report next to the log file, under ~/.local/state/lantern/crashes.

Tool descriptions cost about 9k tokens; deferred tools keep the prompt under budget.

candidates.body:
# Sandbox
The sandbox VM is a box image built with packer, and it has no network.
